_readme: Payload de intake de My Guest con la FORMA REAL del webhook de Tally.
PROCEDENCIA: la estructura (ids de pregunta, titulos, tipos y uuids de opcion) se
tomo de la submission REAL X5YjRRd del formulario vivo MedpvA -- la prueba LIVE
controlada G-06 del 2026-07-02, 34 respuestas -- consultando la API de Tally el
2026-07-26. No habia ninguna submission guardada en KV ni en data/: el KV solo
conserva 4 llaves con TTL y ninguna es un intake.
El sobre (data.fields[] con key/label/type/value/options y data.hiddenFields) es el
formato de webhook de Tally que consume worker.js; la API de submissions expone los
mismos datos con otra forma (responses[] con questionId/answer).
DATOS: los textos genericos de hospitalidad (House Rules, Things to know, Before you
leave, Additional notes, Welcome Message, Amenities, horarios) se conservan tal cual
venian: no identifican a nadie.
TODO dato sensible o identificable es FICTICIO, por la regla dura del repo (nada
sensible en HTML publico ni en un fixture commiteado): wifi_ssid, wifi_password,
host_phone y Private access details son inventados -- los codigos son 0000 a
proposito -- y tambien lo son el nombre y direccion de la propiedad, el order_id, el
correo del cliente, el instagram, el link de resenas y los nombres de restaurantes,
bares y actividades.
PREGUNTAS QUE EL ANFITRION REAL DEJO VACIAS (y por eso no aparecen aqui): Google
maps Link, About Hosts, Pet Rules, los maps_link de restaurantes y bares, los
activity_4/5, emergency_contacts y los adjuntos (Existing book file / photos).

fields.label: Property Address
fields.value: 145 Calle Ficticia, Colonia Inventada, Ciudad Demo

fields.label: Additional notes
fields.value: This property is being used for a controlled LIVE test of the MyGuest purchase and delivery flow. All information is dummy test data and should not be used for a real guest stay.

fields.label: Public arrival instructions
fields.value: Porton negro justo enfrente de la plaza ficticia; la entrada peatonal esta a la izquierda del porton.

fields.label: Private access details
fields.value:
Al llegar, la caja de llaves esta a la derecha de la puerta principal.
Codigo de la caja de llaves: 0000 (ficticio).
Codigo del porton peatonal: 0000# (ficticio).
Dentro encontraras dos llaves: la grande abre la puerta principal y la pequena el cuarto de lavado.
Si la caja no abre, escribe al telefono del anfitrion que aparece en la seccion de Contacto.

fields.label: Parking Info
fields.value: Un lugar de estacionamiento disponible dentro del condominio ficticio.

fields.label: Welcome Message
fields.value: Bienvenidos a tu hogar en la playa

fields.label: House Rules
fields.value:
House rules:
- No smoking inside the property.
- No parties or events.
- Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.
- No extra guests without prior approval.
- Please turn off the air conditioning when leaving.
- Please lock all doors and windows when leaving.
- Report any damage or issue as soon as possible.

fields.label: Things to know
fields.value:
Air conditioning:
Use the remote control in the living room. Please keep doors and windows closed while the AC is running.

Hot water:
Hot water is available in the shower. Let the water run for 30–60 seconds.

Kitchen:
Guests may use the kitchen, coffee maker, refrigerator, microwave, dishes, and basic utensils.

Coffee:
A small starter amount of coffee is provided.

Trash:
Please place trash in the bin under the kitchen sink. For longer stays, take trash to the building trash area near the main entrance.

Laundry:
There is no in-unit laundry for this test property.

TV / Streaming:
The TV is available for guest use. Please use your own streaming accounts and log out before checkout.

Pool / Common areas:
No pool for this test property.

Beach towels:
Two beach towels are available in the closet.

Safe / valuables:
There is no safe. Please keep valuables with you.

fields.label: Before you leave
fields.value:
Checkout instructions:
- Wash any used dishes.
- Place used towels in the bathroom.
- Take out the trash if needed.
- Turn off lights and air conditioning.
- Close windows.
- Lock the door.
- Send the host a quick message once you have checked out.

fields.label: Transport Options
fields.value: Sitio de taxis enfrente de la casa y parada de autobus en la esquina. Uber y DiDi operan en la zona.
